culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yumi Nakata. Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height.

motive.quote: Kyouko and Senta ask why she killed Kazuki and she reveals that she did it in revenge for him causing the death of Chizu’s mother and for putting Chizu into a coma.

method.quote: Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death.

evidence.quote: While a photo revealed that Yumi’s hair was shoulder length, which meant that she did not have enough hair to tie it into a bun.

motive.zhHans: Kyouko 和 Senta 问她为什么杀了 Kazuki，她透露自己这么做是为了报复——他造成了 Chizu 母亲的死亡，并使 Chizu 陷入昏迷。Yumi 得知真相后，故意邀请 Kazuki、Senta 和 Kyouko 到酒店，为复仇而杀死 Kazuki。最终，Taka'aki 没有向 Yamamura 透露他兄弟的死讯，因为毕竟 Hiro 是 Yamamura 的挚友，他希望保留两人目前都在伸张正义的希望。
motive.en: Kyouko and Senta ask why she killed Kazuki and she reveals that she did it in revenge for him causing the death of Chizu’s mother and for putting Chizu into a coma. After Yumi learned the truth, she intentionally invited Kazuki, Senta, and Kyouko to the hotel to kill Kazuki in revenge. In the end, Taka’aki hasn't revealed his brother’s death to Yamamura because, after all, Hiro was a dear friend of Yamamura, and he wants to keep his hope that both of them are currently serving justice.

method.zhHans: Yumi 用了某种手法，让自己看起来仍待在自己的公寓里，而实际上她正在停车场把 Kazuki Tsukishima 打死。Yumi 在环形灯上搭了一条毛巾，并在顶部绑了一根橡皮筋来模仿自己的发髻，然后她把环形灯放在一个行李箱上，以匹配自己的身高。Yumi 用 blackjack 杀死了 Kazuki，做法是把重物放进袜子里，以足以致人死亡的力量挥动它。她用了 Kazuki 的袜子和自己的一个物件来制作 blackjack。柯南问小五郎他对这个手法的解释是否正确。
method.en: Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height. Yumi used a blackjack to kill Kazuki, it involves placing a heavy object into a sock and swinging it with enough force to kill someone. She used Kazuki’s sock and an object of her own to create a blackjack. Conan asking Kogoro if his explanation about the trick is right.

evidence.zhHans: 而一张照片显示 Yumi 的头发是齐肩长度，这意味着她没有足够的头发把它扎成发髻。动机 Uehara 警探问她为什么不干脆丢弃证据，但她狠不下心，因为那个腕部负重是 Chizu Yuba 送给她的。然而，Yumi 觉得奇怪，因为她知道他们有时间救下两个人，却还是失败了。多年后她得知了真相：Chizu 翻看了 Kazuki 的笔记本电脑，发现了他录下的那决定命运的一天的视频。
evidence.en: While a photo revealed that Yumi’s hair was shoulder length, which meant that she did not have enough hair to tie it into a bun. Motive Detective Uehara asks why she didn’t just discard the evidence, but she didn’t have the heart to as the wrist weight was given to her by Chizu Yuba. However, Yumi found it strange as she knew they had enough time to save both of them and yet they failed. Years later she learned the truth, Chizu had been looking around Kazuki’s laptop and found a video that he recorded of that fateful day.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yumi Nakata。Yumi 用了某种手法，让自己看起来仍待在自己的公寓里，而实际上她正在停车场把 Kazuki Tsukishima 打死。Yumi 在环形灯上搭了一条毛巾，并在顶部绑了一根橡皮筋来模仿自己的发髻，然后她把环形灯放在一个行李箱上，以匹配自己的身高。然后她把一根连着窗帘的绳子系好，把另一端系在她的第一部手机上，并把它放在窗边桌子的边缘。杀害 Kazuki 之后，她用自己的第二部手机拨打第一部手机的号码，这使手机从桌上掉落，把窗帘拉开。这制造了她拉开窗帘向外张望的假象，而这一幕也被监控摄像头拍了下来。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yumi Nakata. Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height. She then tied a string connected to her curtain and attached the other end to her first cellphone and set it on the edge of a table next to the window. After she murdered Kazuki, she dialed the number of her first cellphone with her second one, which caused the phone to fall off the table pulling the curtain open. This gave the illusion that she had opened her curtain to peer outside, which was also captured on the surveillance camera.
